`calamine_issue_419.xlsb` is the unmodified Calamine regression fixture from
https://github.com/tafia/calamine/blob/master/tests/issue_419.xlsb
(retrieved 2026-10-18). It contains a single `Hello` cell and verifies genuine
binary XLSB parsing plus header-only table preview. Its upstream MIT license
is reproduced in LICENSE-calamine-MIT.md. Other format fixtures are generated
in pytest temporary directories from declared test dependencies.
